verses.text: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
lines: A gentle answer turns away wrath,
but a harsh word stirs up anger.

verses.text: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of fools gush out folly.
lines: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge,
but the mouth of fools gush out folly.

verses.text: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
lines: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere,
keeping watch on the evil and the good.

verses.text: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
lines: A gentle tongue is a tree of life,
but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

verses.text: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
lines: A fool despises his father’s correction,
but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.

verses.text: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.
lines: In the house of the righteous is much treasure,
but the income of the wicked brings trouble.

verses.text: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
lines: The lips of the wise spread knowledge;
not so with the heart of fools.

verses.text: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
lines: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh,
but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

verses.text: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.
lines: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh,
but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

verses.text: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.
lines: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way:
whoever hates reproof shall die.

verses.text: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!
lines: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh—
how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

verses.text: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
lines: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved;
he will not go to the wise.

verses.text: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.
lines: A glad heart makes a cheerful face,
but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

verses.text: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
lines: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge,
but the mouths of fools feed on folly.

verses.text: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
lines: All the days of the afflicted are wretched,
but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.

verses.text: Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.
lines: Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh,
than great treasure with trouble.

verses.text: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
lines: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is,
than a fattened calf with hatred.

verses.text: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
lines: A wrathful man stirs up contention,
but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

verses.text: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.
lines: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch,
but the path of the upright is a highway.

verses.text: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
lines: A wise son makes a father glad,
but a foolish man despises his mother.

verses.text: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.
lines: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom,
but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.

verses.text: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
lines: Where there is no counsel, plans fail;
but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

verses.text: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
lines: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth.
How good is a word at the right time!

verses.text: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
lines: The path of life leads upward for the wise,
to keep him from going downward to Sheol.

verses.text: Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.
lines: Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud,
but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.

verses.text: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.
lines: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked,
but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

verses.text: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.
lines: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house,
but he who hates bribes will live.

verses.text: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
lines: The heart of the righteous weighs answers,
but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

verses.text: Yahweh is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
lines: Yahweh is far from the wicked,
but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

verses.text: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
lines: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart.
Good news gives health to the bones.

verses.text: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
lines: The ear that listens to reproof lives,
and will be at home among the wise.

verses.text: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
lines: He who refuses correction despises his own soul,
but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.

verses.text: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
lines: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom.
Before honor is humility.
